instruction:
Please act as a professional Verilog designer. Design a pipelined module that implements a 4-bit ripple carry adder/subtractor. 
The module should have three inputs, A, B, and sub, each 4 bits wide. A and B represent the operands, and sub represents the operation: 
when sub is high, the module should perform subtraction; when sub is low, the module should perform addition. 
The module should have two outputs, sum and carry_out, representing the result and the carry-out bit, respectively. 
Utilize pipeline structure to achieve this functionality.
